scope: main_claim and main_claim_direct with their complete transitive source dependencies and independent verification tools
proof_policy: No proof holes, custom axioms or compiler-trust bypasses; allow propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound
changes_allowed: Build portability, public documentation, measured proof-preserving performance changes; preserve mathematical definitions and theorem statements
external_action_authorization: User requested push only after successful checks; no visibility change
license_policy: Preserve third-party notices and existing ownership; do not assign a new license to original work without authorization
maintenance: Maintained repository; retain provenance and update verification evidence with later changes
